results.title: 75% of US health systems use, plan to use an AI in 2026: survey
results.content: * [Fierce Pharma](https://www.fiercepharma.com/). * [Fierce Healthcare](https://www.fiercehealthcare.com/). + [Special Report](https://www.fiercepharma.com/collection/fierce-50-2025 "Special Report"). + [Special Report](https://www.fiercepharma.com/collection/fierce-50-2025 "Special Report"). * [Fierce Pharma](https://www.fiercepharma.com/). * [Fierce Healthcare](https://www.fiercehealthcare.com/). # Health system AI adoption surges in 2026 with execs reporting increased ROI: survey. Seventy-five percent of U.S. health systems are now using at least one artificial intelligence application, up from 59% in 2025, a new survey from [Eliciting Insights](https://elicitinginsights.com/) found. The go-to market research firm’s survey ([PDF](https://elicitinginsights.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/219_ElicitingInsights_AI_Infographic_Feb2026_Final.pdf)) polled executives from 120 health systems across the U.S. for its second annual AI Adoption Survey. * AI-based clinical documentation improvement: 43% adoption, 59% growth YoY. * AI coding solutions: 36% adoption, 29% growth YoY. * AI denial prediction: 25% adoption, 4% growth YoY. * AI admin chatbots: 25% adoption, 19% growth YoY. * AI prepopulated technical appeals: 21% adoption, 50% growth YoY. * AI prepopulated clinical appeals: 19% adoption, 27% growth YoY.
